subject: Request: MedSight - SLO / service credit carveout + commercial offset
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@medsight.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SLA carveout and reduced service-credit cap for pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We’re moving toward a pilot with a 6-month commitment and expect to scale quickly if the pilot goes well. One thing came up in our procurement review: MedSight needs an exception to the uptime SLO for the first 6 months (we’ve asked for 99.5% instead of 99.9%) and would like the standard service-credit maximum reduced to 25% for that period. In exchange we’re prepared to sign a 12-month committed volume with a 15% ARR discount and a 6-month prepay of two months of committed spend.

I attached the procurement note and a draft SOW (referenced). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate these non-standard terms and what approvals would be required?

Olivia Barnes
Head of Cloud Ops
MedSight AI

Attachments: procurement_note.pdf (summary), draft_SOW_medsight.pdf (stub)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: SLA carveout and reduced service-credit cap for pilot

Folks — forwarding Olivia's procurement ask. Quick summary:
- Customer: MedSight AI (healthcare imaging SaaS)
- Ask: temporary SLO relaxation to 99.5% for first 6 months + cap service credits at 25% for that period
- Commercial offset: 15% ARR discount, 12-month committed term, 2-month prepay

Can Deal Desk/legal/ops do a read on risk and pricing impact? Need executive signoff if we want to make this binding. Please see attachments (I uploaded the SOW/SLA draft and procurement note to the Drive link below) and advise next steps — if you recommend an approval path, can you also outline any conditions (monitoring instrumentation, penalties if post-pilot SLA drops)?

Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Related docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MedsightDocs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: legal_deal_desk@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SLA carveout and reduced service-credit cap for pilot

Irene / Karthik — reviewed the ask and did a quick ops/risk pass with infra and legal. Key points:
- Ops: temporary 99.5% SLO for a 6-month pilot is feasible if we scope a tightly constrained instance pool (dedicated pool preferred) and require explicit capacity reservations. We'll need an infra runbook itemizing failover steps and a monitoring hook (token-level latency traces + uptime alerts forwarded to MedSight ops).
- Risk/Finance: reducing the service-credit cap to 25% materially reduces our liability but still requires exec approval to sign off on a deviation from standard SLA templates.
- Legal: will require a carveout clause in the SLA and a one-time exec-signed deviation sheet. They flagged that "cap on credits" must be explicitly tied to the pilot term and the committed spend.

Attachments: SLA_proposal_v1.xlsx (redlines), SOW_medsight_draft.pdf (annotated) — uploaded to Drive.

Recommend: escalate to VP Commercial (Vivek) for approval with conditions: 1) commit to a dedicated pool for pilot or guaranteed burst capacity; 2) include instrumentation/alerting obligations for MedSight; 3) cap service credits at 25% for pilot term only; 4) require 2% uplift to the committed monthly spend if we accept a sizable credit reduction (to preserve economics). If VP signs off, legal can finalize the deviation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_proposal_v1.xlsx, SOW_medsight_draft.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request for Exec Approval: MedSight pilot SLO deviation + commercial offset (DEAL-2026-0587)

Vivek — quick ask for your signoff. Deal summary below: 
- Customer: MedSight AI (healthcare)
- Proposed deviation: temporary SLO change to 99.5% (6 months), service-credit cap at 25% for pilot term only
- Commercial offset: 12-month committed term, 15% ARR discount, 2 months prepay (equates to ~14% effective), Marissa recommends a 2% uplift to committed monthly spend to balance risk
- Operational guardrails: dedicated pool or guaranteed burst capacity, real-time alerting forwarded to customer, success milestones and weekly ops reviews during pilot
- Legal: will draft a one-off deviation sheet; marketing/PR unaffected

Attached are Marissa's redlines and the SOW. Approving this will let us close the pilot this quarter and unlock enterprise negotiation — customer indicated a likely expansion to multi-region production if pilot meets latency/quality gates.

Can you provide an approval or request modifications? If you approve, please include any extra conditions you want on the record.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, legal_deal_desk@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 15:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for Exec Approval: MedSight pilot SLO deviation + commercial offset (DEAL-2026-0587)

Thanks team — I reviewed the summary and Marissa’s recommendations. I approve the proposed SLO deviation and reduced credit cap under these firm conditions: 
1) SLO change to 99.5% limited to a 6-month pilot window only; after the pilot we must transition to our standard SLO or re-open negotiation.
2) Cap service credits at 25% for the pilot term; any credit exposure beyond that requires a separate exec-level remediation signoff.
3) Require a dedicated or reserved capacity pool for the pilot (ops to confirm sizing) and weekly ops reviews with MedSight for the pilot duration.
4) Contractual condition: require a 2% uplift to committed monthly spend (applied as a minimum monthly commitment floor) to offset the reduced credit exposure.
5) Legal to prepare a Deviation Addendum and require MedSight to sign prior to pilot start; Commercial to secure the 12-month commitment and 2-month prepay.

Once legal confirms the addendum language and ops signs off on capacity/runbook, Marissa — please proceed to finalize. Irene — tell Olivia we can proceed on these terms and route the addendum to their contracts team.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
